items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: I think it was The Clique Club, owned by a mafia guy named Frank Palumbo or something like that.

ctx.x: Yeah. I think it was The Clique Club, owned by a mafia guy named Frank Palumbo or something like that. He owned most of Philadelphia. But I do remember this gig. 1952. How about that. Boy that band was a great band.
How did you like playing with Kenton as opposed to Woody Herman?
